rationale: The capture's motion freeze now waits, bounded at 500 ms of real time on the Node side, for two animation frames after any pass that changed an animation or video, so the compositor receives the frozen state before virtual time pauses and the screenshot horizon cannot accept a stale composited frame. Outcomes are recorded in provenance.motion.frame_commit_waits. No captured value, lowering rule or DesignIR schema changes; Chromium stays the oracle.
